import json, sys
from fractions import Fraction

N_MIN, N_MAX = 1, 7                     # certificate scope: witnessed range

def _reject_float(s):
    raise RuntimeError("FAIL: float literal in certificate: %r (exact rationals only)" % (s,))
def _reject_const(s):
    raise RuntimeError("FAIL: non-finite constant in certificate: %r" % (s,))
def require(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        raise RuntimeError("FAIL: " + msg)

def main(path):
    with open(path, "r") as fh:
        cert = json.load(fh, parse_float=_reject_float, parse_constant=_reject_const)

    fam = cert.get("family")            # -- O1 gate: frozen family --
    require(isinstance(fam, dict), "no frozen family F")
    require(isinstance(fam.get("name"), str) and fam["name"], "family.name missing")
    require(isinstance(fam.get("definition"), str) and fam["definition"],
            "family.definition missing (must be a decidable predicate)")
    require(isinstance(fam.get("size_parameter"), str), "family.size_parameter missing")

    require(cert.get("direction") == "F_N >= c_N",
            "claim direction unresolved (abort on unresolved sign)")

    wit = cert.get("witnesses")         # -- O2 gate: exact integer witnesses --
    require(isinstance(wit, list) and wit, "no exact witnesses {N,F(N)}")
    seen = {}
    for w in wit:
        require(isinstance(w, dict), "witness entry not an object")
        N, FN = w.get("N"), w.get("F_N")
        require(isinstance(N, int) and not isinstance(N, bool), "witness N must be integer")
        require(isinstance(FN, int) and not isinstance(FN, bool),
                "F(N) must be exact integer (got %r)" % (FN,))
        require(N_MIN <= N <= N_MAX, "witness N=%d outside scope 1..%d" % (N, N_MAX))
        require(N not in seen, "duplicate witness N=%d" % N)
        seen[N] = FN
    miss = [N for N in range(N_MIN, N_MAX + 1) if N not in seen]
    require(not miss, "missing integer witnesses for N=%s" % (miss,))

    bnds = cert.get("bounds")           # -- O3 gate: exact rational bounds --
    require(isinstance(bnds, list) and bnds, "no exact c(N)")
    bseen = {}
    for b in bnds:
        require(isinstance(b, dict), "bound entry not an object")
        N, cN = b.get("N"), b.get("c_N")
        require(isinstance(N, int) and not isinstance(N, bool), "bound N must be integer")
        require(N in seen, "bound for unwitnessed N=%d" % N)
        require(isinstance(cN, str) and cN, "c_N must be an exact rational string")
        c = Fraction(cN)                # exact parse; never rounds; malformed => raise
        require(c > 0, "vacuous bound c(%d) <= 0" % N)
        require(Fraction(seen[N]) >= c,
                "exact inequality violated at N=%d: F=%d < c=%s" % (N, seen[N], cN))
        bseen[N] = c
    missb = [N for N in range(N_MIN, N_MAX + 1) if N not in bseen]
    require(not missb, "missing exact bound c(N) for N=%s" % (missb,))

    tr = cert.get("transference")       # -- O4 gate: proved transference --
    require(isinstance(tr, dict), "no transference block")
    require(tr.get("status") == "PROVED_BY", "finite->asymptotic reduction not proved")
    ref = tr.get("reduction_ref")
    require(isinstance(ref, str) and ref and ref != "none",
            "transference.reduction_ref missing (analytic reduction = none)")

    print("PASS")                       # the only success exit

if __name__ == "__main__":
